column1: # The explain targets: one (project, package) pair per line, tab separated.
# Hand-picked on 2026-09-23 out of the 4,124 findings of the 39-project corpus, chosen to span all
# nine verdicts, all five priorities and all ten signals S1-S10 across 24 of the 39 projects. There
# is no generator and there cannot be one: regenerating the list from a run's findings would reduce
# it to whatever the corpus happens to contain that day, which is the opposite of what it is for.
# It decays, because a refreshed corpus may no longer install the package a line names. That decay
# is meant to be read, not guessed at: `corpus explain` records every target it could not render,
# and `corpus check` reports the pairs it did not get.
